result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, promotional tone in first-person plural ('we'). Customers and people are addressed first, with innovation as the dominant theme. Commitments are stated absolutely ('we want', 'we must') with little hedging. Energy transition appears only in a closing call-to-action section, which reads as a product promotion rather than a stated value.
